theros.rule.setessan-gender-roles.cost_or_limit: The roles are flexible; some people change roles or live outside the gender dichotomy.
theros.rule.setessan-gender-roles.combines: Ophis Tower warriors combine martial training with wandering and service.
theros.rule.setessan-gender-roles.blocked_reason: The passage describes variable social identities, not a supernatural transformation.

theros.rule.kelema-veil.name: Kelema Veil

effect.summary: none

theros.rule.kelema-veil.cost_or_limit: It manifests at seasonal nexus points between the mortal world and Nyx.
theros.rule.kelema-veil.who_may: Oracles seek messages from the divine there.
theros.rule.kelema-veil.combines: Star fields and omens appear at the sites.
theros.rule.kelema-veil.blocked_reason: The Veil supports supernatural signs and messages.

theros.rule.returned-memories-become-eid.name: Returned memories become eidolons

effect.summary: A person returning from the Underworld does not regain their memories; those memories wander as eidolons.

theros.rule.returned-memories-become-eid.cost_or_limit: The Returned retain personality and skills but not memories.
theros.rule.returned-memories-become-eid.mind: Returned are confused and often bitter or lonely.
theros.rule.returned-memories-become-eid.blocked_reason: It governs the separation of a returned being from its memories and the persistence of those memories as entities.

theros.rule.kruphix-contains-the-tovian-.name: Kruphix contains the Tovian conflict

effect.summary: Kruphix's influence surrounds the Tovian Fields' battle and prevents it spreading through Nyx.

theros.rule.kruphix-contains-the-tovian-.cost_or_limit: Kruphix has no central residence there; his influence covers the border.
theros.rule.kruphix-contains-the-tovian-.go_wrong: If containment fails, the conflict could spill into Nyx.
theros.rule.kruphix-contains-the-tovian-.combines: Contains the war of Mogis and Iroas.
theros.rule.kruphix-contains-the-tovian-.blocked_reason: The rule requires a persistent containment boundary that prevents an ongoing conflict from propagating.

theros.rule.underworld-entry-and-soul-de.name: Underworld entry and soul destination

effect.summary: The dead reach the Underworld, and souls are routed to their destined ward.

theros.rule.underworld-entry-and-soul-de.cost_or_limit: Living entry requires magic or hidden pathways; death also provides access.
theros.rule.underworld-entry-and-soul-de.who_may: Dead sapient creatures; living travelers with access.
theros.rule.underworld-entry-and-soul-de.where_from: The passage’s description of the Underworld.
theros.rule.underworld-entry-and-soul-de.combines: Souls meet Athreos at the Tartyx and may pay for ferry service.
theros.rule.underworld-entry-and-soul-de.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar cannot represent death, afterlife status, or permanent soul destination.

theros.rule.underworld-travel.name: Underworld travel

effect.summary: Each ward is effectively infinite, and travel between notable sites is usually impossible on foot.

theros.rule.underworld-travel.cost_or_limit: Secret paths, magical steeds, or powerful residents may speed travel.
theros.rule.underworld-travel.combines: The wards connect to the Tartyx.
theros.rule.underworld-travel.blocked_reason: The restriction is a travel rule rather than a power effect.

theros.rule.athreos-s-ferry-payment.name: Athreos’s ferry payment

effect.summary: Souls capable of paying Athreos are ferried to their new home.

theros.rule.athreos-s-ferry-payment.cost_or_limit: Payment is required for Athreos’s service.
theros.rule.athreos-s-ferry-payment.go_wrong: Unpaid souls may remain stranded at the river.
theros.rule.athreos-s-ferry-payment.where_from: The Tartyx and Athreos’s ferry service.
theros.rule.athreos-s-ferry-payment.combines: Crossing points and discarded coins appear along the river.
theros.rule.athreos-s-ferry-payment.blocked_reason: The rule makes passage depend on a dead soul’s state and payment.

theros.rule.blessing-duration-and-stacki.name: Blessing duration and stacking

effect.summary: A blessing lasts until its granting god removes it; multiple blessings are allowed, but duplicate applications do not stack.

theros.rule.blessing-duration-and-stacki.cost_or_limit: A character cannot gain simultaneous benefit from multiple copies of one blessing.
theros.rule.blessing-duration-and-stacki.go_wrong: A god can revoke a blessing, potentially when piety falls.
theros.rule.blessing-duration-and-stacki.combines: Blessings are not suppressed by antimagic fields.
theros.rule.blessing-duration-and-stacki.mechanism: Persistent, non-dispellable boon with duplicate-effect restriction.
theros.rule.blessing-duration-and-stacki.blocked_reason: This is a direct duration and stacking rule.

theros.rule.piety-requirements-for-item-.name: Piety requirements for item-like blessings

effect.summary: A blessing duplicating an item’s effect requires piety based on the item’s rarity.

theros.rule.piety-requirements-for-item-.cost_or_limit: Thresholds are 3 for uncommon, 10 for rare, 25 for very rare, and 50 for legendary.
theros.rule.piety-requirements-for-item-.combines: Applies to blessings that duplicate magic items.

theros.rule.divine-emissary-nature.name: Divine emissary nature

effect.summary: Emissaries are will-less Nyx-born agents that return to Nyx when their mission ends.

theros.rule.divine-emissary-nature.cost_or_limit: They serve a specific mission and are at least one size larger than normal.
theros.rule.divine-emissary-nature.combines: May have one or two Nyxborn traits, often magic resistance or magic weapons.
theros.rule.divine-emissary-nature.blocked_reason: The rule specifies a being with no will of its own and a mission-bound existence.

theros.rule.divine-ordeal-eligibility.name: Divine ordeal eligibility

effect.summary: A hero who reaches Nyx is generally worthy to request an ordeal, even without worshipping that god.

theros.rule.divine-ordeal-eligibility.cost_or_limit: A god usually grants each champion one ordeal in a lifetime; exceptions are rare.
theros.rule.divine-ordeal-eligibility.who_may: Heroes capable of reaching Nyx may request an ordeal.
theros.rule.divine-ordeal-eligibility.combines: A god may test several group members separately.
theros.rule.divine-ordeal-eligibility.blocked_reason: This is an access and frequency rule.

theros.rule.divine-ordeal-reward.name: Divine ordeal reward

effect.summary: A successful hero may request a reward such as a miracle, supernatural gift, or magic item.

theros.rule.divine-ordeal-reward.cost_or_limit: The god determines the request’s outcome; success is required.
theros.rule.divine-ordeal-reward.go_wrong: No ordinary penalty for failure is stated.
theros.rule.divine-ordeal-reward.who_may: Heroes who succeed at an ordeal.
theros.rule.divine-ordeal-reward.combines: Possible rewards include divine intervention, a supernatural gift, or a suitable magic item.
theros.rule.divine-ordeal-reward.blocked_reason: The rule allows a god to grant powers or items to a character.

theros.rule.underworld-crossing-traps.name: Underworld crossing traps

effect.summary: The temple’s magical traps keep the living out of the dead’s realm and the dead from returning to the living.

theros.rule.underworld-crossing-traps.cost_or_limit: Traps activate in the presence of mortals; glyphs can blast energy and collapse ceilings.
theros.rule.underworld-crossing-traps.go_wrong: Unauthorized entry or return triggers destructive defenses.
theros.rule.underworld-crossing-traps.who_may: The traps affect living intruders and returning dead.
theros.rule.underworld-crossing-traps.blocked_reason: The rule imposes a crossing-specific restriction on who can pass between realms.

theros.rule.dead-enter-the-underworld.name: Dead enter the Underworld

effect.summary: The dead are expected to pass into the Underworld, though some may fail to arrive or escape.

theros.rule.dead-enter-the-underworld.go_wrong: Souls can remain as spirits or return as Returned.
theros.rule.dead-enter-the-underworld.blocked_reason: The rule requires modeling souls moving into and out of an afterlife.

theros.rule.erebos-s-champions-serve-bey.name: Erebos's champions serve beyond death

effect.summary: A champion's service to Erebos continues after the champion dies.

theros.rule.erebos-s-champions-serve-bey.go_wrong: Breaking sacred rules can cause Erebos to turn against the champion.
theros.rule.erebos-s-champions-serve-bey.blocked_reason: The rule requires a character's obligations and agency to persist after death.

theros.rule.returned-can-linger-near-the.name: Returned can linger near their burial place

effect.summary: Returned may remain by their burial place because they do not remember where else to go.

theros.rule.returned-can-linger-near-the.go_wrong: They can become lost or terrorize others.
theros.rule.returned-can-linger-near-the.mind: They may not remember where to go.
theros.rule.returned-can-linger-near-the.blocked_reason: The rule links a dead person's return to memory and continued existence.

theros.rule.ephara-s-favor-can-be-lost.name: Ephara's favor can be lost

effect.summary: Champions who falter in their major goals can lose Ephara's favor and must prove themselves again.

theros.rule.ephara-s-favor-can-be-lost.cost_or_limit: Failure to meet major goals risks loss of favor.

theros.rule.keranos-s-realm-follows-uniq.name: Keranos's realm follows unique physical laws

effect.summary: A divine realm can operate under its own physical rules, which may spread outward.

theros.rule.keranos-s-realm-follows-uniq.cost_or_limit: The alternate reality begins in a realm among the Dakra Isles.
theros.rule.keranos-s-realm-follows-uniq.go_wrong: Escaped inhabitants infect the wider world with its rules.
theros.rule.keranos-s-realm-follows-uniq.combines: Its influence can extend through inhabitants.
theros.rule.keranos-s-realm-follows-uniq.blocked_reason: A place-specific world rule is a mechanism rather than a character effect.

theros.rule.klothys-holds-the-titans-in-.name: Klothys holds the titans in the Underworld

effect.summary: Klothys continually knots destiny to keep the titans imprisoned.

theros.rule.klothys-holds-the-titans-in-.cost_or_limit: Her vigilance must continue without interruption.
theros.rule.klothys-holds-the-titans-in-.go_wrong: Without her vigilance, the titans might reclaim the mortal realm.
theros.rule.klothys-holds-the-titans-in-.combines: Her spindle knots and unravels strands of destiny.
theros.rule.klothys-holds-the-titans-in-.blocked_reason: The passage gives a continuing cosmic prison, not a basic effect with a simple target.

theros.rule.passage-beyond-the-world-s-w.name: Passage beyond the world's waterfall

effect.summary: At Kruphix's world-edge temple, mortals may pass directly into Nyx; elsewhere crossing the waterfall leads to the Underworld.

theros.rule.passage-beyond-the-world-s-w.cost_or_limit: The safe passage is limited to a few places, including the temple at the world's edge.
theros.rule.passage-beyond-the-world-s-w.go_wrong: Crossing elsewhere sends travelers into the Underworld.
theros.rule.passage-beyond-the-world-s-w.who_may: Mortals who reach the appropriate passage.
theros.rule.passage-beyond-the-world-s-w.where_from: The edge of the mortal realm
theros.rule.passage-beyond-the-world-s-w.combines: The temple's location is not shown on maps.
theros.rule.passage-beyond-the-world-s-w.blocked_reason: The passage describes a location-dependent movement rule.

theros.rule.healing-pool-offering-judgme.name: Healing pool offering judgment

effect.summary: A worthy offering earns curative waters; an unworthy one causes poisoning, while someone without an offering may volunteer for experiments.

theros.rule.healing-pool-offering-judgme.cost_or_limit: Healing depends on Pharika judging an offering worthy
theros.rule.healing-pool-offering-judgme.go_wrong: An unworthy offering worsens the bather’s condition
theros.rule.healing-pool-offering-judgme.who_may: People who bathe after making an offering or volunteering

theros.rule.island-visitor-enchantment.name: Island visitor enchantment

effect.summary: Some island effects can make visitors resist leaving.

theros.rule.island-visitor-enchantment.cost_or_limit: A visitor makes a DC 10 Wisdom save after each long rest; three failures make them unwilling to leave permanently.
theros.rule.island-visitor-enchantment.go_wrong: Forced removal leads the visitor to try to return.
theros.rule.island-visitor-enchantment.mind: Compels the visitor to stay or return.
theros.rule.island-visitor-enchantment.combines: Dispel evil and good removes the effect.
theros.rule.island-visitor-enchantment.blocked_reason: It imposes a persistent compulsion and return-seeking behavior not supported by the basic effect grammar.

theros.rule.curse-of-the-swine.name: Curse of the Swine

effect.summary: Visitors may become pigs after resting on the island.

theros.rule.curse-of-the-swine.cost_or_limit: A DC 10 Wisdom save is required after each long rest on the island.
theros.rule.curse-of-the-swine.go_wrong: Failure transforms the visitor into a pig using the boar statistics.
theros.rule.curse-of-the-swine.combines: The curse ends on leaving the island or through a spell such as remove curse.
theros.rule.curse-of-the-swine.blocked_reason: It transforms a visitor's body into an animal form.

theros.rule.timeless-island-time-shift.name: Timeless Island time shift

effect.summary: Time outside may pass differently while visitors remain on the island.

theros.rule.timeless-island-time-shift.cost_or_limit: Applies after characters spend at least one day on the island and leave.
theros.rule.timeless-island-time-shift.go_wrong: The amount of shifted time is variable.
theros.rule.timeless-island-time-shift.combines: The Dungeon Master's Guide Feywild Time Warp table determines the shift.

theros.rule.wild-magic-island-spell-surg.name: Wild Magic Island spell surge

effect.summary: Casting a spell on the island causes a wild-magic surge roll.

theros.rule.wild-magic-island-spell-surg.cost_or_limit: Triggers whenever a spell is cast on the island.
theros.rule.wild-magic-island-spell-surg.go_wrong: The result is determined by the Wild Magic Surge table.
theros.rule.wild-magic-island-spell-surg.combines: Uses the Player's Handbook Wild Magic Surge table.
theros.rule.wild-magic-island-spell-surg.blocked_reason: The passage relies on an external surge table for variable spell side effects.

theros.rule.underworld-bodily-survival.name: Underworld bodily survival

effect.summary: Living visitors remain alive in the Underworld and retain ordinary bodily needs.

theros.rule.underworld-bodily-survival.cost_or_limit: They age, take damage, heal naturally, and need air, food, drink, and sleep.
theros.rule.underworld-bodily-survival.go_wrong: The hazardous realm can kill them.
theros.rule.underworld-bodily-survival.combines: They may be exposed to dangerous environments and creatures.

theros.rule.underworld-soul-identity.name: Underworld soul identity

effect.summary: A dead person's soul retains its memories, skills, and game statistics.

theros.rule.underworld-soul-identity.cost_or_limit: Souls do not need food, drink, or sleep, though deprivation can torment them.
theros.rule.underworld-soul-identity.combines: A soul can experience hunger and thirst without their normal exhaustion effects.
theros.rule.underworld-soul-identity.blocked_reason: The rule defines identity and bodily needs after death.

theros.rule.underworld-soul-reanimation.name: Underworld soul reanimation

effect.summary: A soul that dies in the Underworld reanimates at the start of its next turn.

theros.rule.underworld-soul-reanimation.cost_or_limit: It returns with one hit point per Hit Die and gains one permanent exhaustion level until restored to life.
theros.rule.underworld-soul-reanimation.go_wrong: Repeated deaths accumulate exhaustion; level six turns the soul into a misera statue that does not rise again.
theros.rule.underworld-soul-reanimation.mind: At high exhaustion the soul's appearance fades and its eyes become blank.
theros.rule.underworld-soul-reanimation.combines: Exhaustion acquired this way vanishes if the soul returns to life.
theros.rule.underworld-soul-reanimation.blocked_reason: It specifies death-state persistence, reanimation timing, and a terminal soul transformation.

theros.rule.athreos-s-fare.name: Athreos's fare

effect.summary: A coin or similar token pays for a soul's passage across the Tartyx.

theros.rule.athreos-s-fare.cost_or_limit: The dead need a token buried with the corpse or funeral rites that provide one.
theros.rule.athreos-s-fare.go_wrong: Unpaid souls cannot reach their place of rest and may become ghosts or other undead.
theros.rule.athreos-s-fare.who_may: Dead souls and living people paying for a soul
theros.rule.athreos-s-fare.combines: Funeral rites or payment by the living can resolve the unpaid fare.
theros.rule.athreos-s-fare.blocked_reason: It determines a soul's post-death movement and state.

theros.rule.underworld-memory-erosion.name: Underworld memory erosion

effect.summary: Funerary masks help newly dead resist erosion of memory and identity.

theros.rule.underworld-memory-erosion.cost_or_limit: The passage gives no further rate or mask requirements.
theros.rule.underworld-memory-erosion.go_wrong: Memory and identity may erode without protection.
theros.rule.underworld-memory-erosion.blocked_reason: It describes memory and identity changing after death.

theros.rule.funeral-coin-and-passage.name: Funeral coin and passage

effect.summary: A buried coin or funeral payment lets a dead soul board Athreos's skiff.

theros.rule.funeral-coin-and-passage.cost_or_limit: Souls without a coin or funeral rites cannot pay the toll.
theros.rule.funeral-coin-and-passage.go_wrong: Unpaid souls languish by the river or may become undead.
theros.rule.funeral-coin-and-passage.who_may: The dead, with payment arranged by the living
theros.rule.funeral-coin-and-passage.where_from: Funeral customs and the Tartyx River
theros.rule.funeral-coin-and-passage.combines: Payment can be buried with the corpse or supplied by the living.
theros.rule.funeral-coin-and-passage.blocked_reason: It controls a soul's passage and fate after death.

theros.rule.spiritual-weathering.name: Spiritual weathering

effect.summary: Dead souls can suffer injury and pain, and may perish over time or after repeated deaths.

theros.rule.spiritual-weathering.go_wrong: Souls may ultimately perish or become petrified.
theros.rule.spiritual-weathering.mechanism: Postmortem attrition and repeat-death state change.
theros.rule.spiritual-weathering.blocked_reason: The rule governs a soul's condition and possible final death.

theros.rule.return-through-the-tartyx.name: Return through the Tartyx

effect.summary: A soul surviving a demon-carried flight across the river is restored to life in the mortal world.

theros.rule.return-through-the-tartyx.cost_or_limit: The journey is lengthy and dangerous.
theros.rule.return-through-the-tartyx.go_wrong: Predatory creatures may attack; the soul may not survive.
theros.rule.return-through-the-tartyx.who_may: A dead soul carried across the river.
theros.rule.return-through-the-tartyx.mechanism: Soul escape and return to life.
theros.rule.return-through-the-tartyx.blocked_reason: The rule changes a dead soul into a living being.

theros.rule.physical-return-of-an-escape.name: Physical return of an escaped soul

effect.summary: An escaped soul becomes a physical being in a new body shaped by its self-image.

theros.rule.physical-return-of-an-escape.cost_or_limit: The new body may differ from the former one.
theros.rule.physical-return-of-an-escape.mind: The body's form reflects the soul's perception of itself.
theros.rule.physical-return-of-an-escape.who_may: A soul that escapes Erebos's clutches.
theros.rule.physical-return-of-an-escape.blocked_reason: The rule creates a body and changes the soul's status.

theros.rule.former-body-after-escape.name: Former body after escape

effect.summary: The old body becomes an empty shell with no connection to the returned soul, and revival spells on it fail.

theros.rule.former-body-after-escape.who_may: A soul that escapes the Underworld.
theros.rule.former-body-after-escape.combines: Resurrection spells have no effect on the old body.
theros.rule.former-body-after-escape.blocked_reason: The rule changes a body's soul relationship and makes revival ineffective.

theros.rule.objects-carried-out-of-the-u.name: Objects carried out of the Underworld

effect.summary: An object taken out becomes a real physical object with the usual properties of its type.

theros.rule.objects-carried-out-of-the-u.cost_or_limit: Must be carried out of the Underworld.
theros.rule.objects-carried-out-of-the-u.blocked_reason: The passage specifies how transported objects acquire physical properties.

theros.rule.blood-foretelling-returned-d.name: Blood foretelling Returned destiny

effect.summary: Orestes's blood-reading vision said black-bleeding people were destined to return as Returned.

theros.rule.blood-foretelling-returned-d.blocked_reason: The rule predicts a future fate, requiring divination beyond the basic effect grammar.

theros.rule.nyxborn-traits.name: Nyxborn traits

effect.summary: Nyxborn beings resemble ordinary creatures but show Nyx's stars in unlit parts; they may also have distinctive magical traits.

theros.rule.nyxborn-traits.where_from: Nyx, divine action, ideals, belief, stories, or dreams
theros.rule.nyxborn-traits.combines: Possible traits include magical resistance, light sensitivity, immutable form, magical weapons, Nyx Step, and starlight glow
theros.rule.nyxborn-traits.blocked_reason: Immutable form requires a rule that blocks transformations.

theros.rule.sea-lock.name: Sea lock

effect.summary: A magical boundary restricts a kraken’s travel while still allowing it to feed.

theros.rule.sea-lock.cost_or_limit: The enclosed area is large enough for feeding but excludes densely populated regions.
theros.rule.sea-lock.go_wrong: Natural disasters may break the lock; some stories attribute it to ancient coral weapons.
theros.rule.sea-lock.who_may: Applies to each kraken under normal circumstances.
theros.rule.sea-lock.combines: May be broken by a seaquake or another natural disaster.
theros.rule.sea-lock.blocked_reason: The rule restricts a creature’s movement within a bounded region.

theros.rule.constructed-nature.name: Constructed Nature

effect.summary: Anvilwroughts do not need air, food, drink, or sleep.

theros.rule.constructed-nature.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward limitation on resource needs.

theros.rule.immortal-nature.name: Immortal Nature

effect.summary: Nymphs do not need food, drink, or sleep; eidolons do not require air, food, drink, or sleep.

theros.rule.immortal-nature.cost_or_limit: Applies to the named undead and nymph beings.
theros.rule.immortal-nature.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward removal of survival requirements.

theros.rule.eidolon-identity-sacrifice.name: Eidolon identity sacrifice

effect.summary: A mortal who traumatically sacrifices identity to escape the Underworld as Returned manifests that identity as an eidolon.

theros.rule.eidolon-identity-sacrifice.cost_or_limit: Requires traumatic sacrifice of identity and escape as Returned.
theros.rule.eidolon-identity-sacrifice.go_wrong: The resulting eidolon is detached from its former experiences.
theros.rule.eidolon-identity-sacrifice.mind: Past-life details persist without a felt connection to the experiences.
theros.rule.eidolon-identity-sacrifice.who_may: Mortal souls escaping the Underworld as Returned.
theros.rule.eidolon-identity-sacrifice.where_from: The described process of becoming Returned.
theros.rule.eidolon-identity-sacrifice.blocked_reason: The rule specifies how soul identity persists and changes after death and escape.

theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.name: Doomwake giant manifestation

effect.summary: Sustained widespread fear of destruction can manifest as a Nyxborn giant that enacts the feared catastrophe.

theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.cost_or_limit: Requires enough mortals in a city or region to dread destruction for a prolonged period.
theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.go_wrong: After the rampage it may fade or persist as a legend with its own terrible life.
theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.mind: The manifestation fulfills the prophecy people believed into being.
theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.who_may: A sufficiently fearful population collectively brings it about.
theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.where_from: Theros’s power of belief and Nyx.
theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.combines: The giant may later fade or become a lasting legend.
theros.rule.doomwake-giant-manifestation.blocked_reason: The rule turns collective belief into an enduring supernatural being, beyond a basic single-target effect.

theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.name: Hundred-Handed One transformation

effect.summary: Archons used dark rituals and stolen ancient giant power to give their artisans many limbs.

theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.cost_or_limit: The account identifies rituals and stolen primal energy as the means.
theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.go_wrong: The transformed giants were cursed with compulsive creation and fled their masters.
theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.mind: The transformation imposed an endless creative drive.
theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.who_may: Archons performed the transformation on giant artisans.
theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.where_from: Ancient giant power and archon magic.
theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.combines: The magic pursued fleeing giants with a curse.
theros.rule.hundred-handed-one-transform.blocked_reason: The rule permanently transforms bodies and adds a lasting mental curse.

theros.rule.nyx-fleece-shearing.name: Nyx-fleece shearing

effect.summary: Undamaged fleece from a Nyx-Fleece Ram can be made into an attuned magical garment with one of several determined properties.

theros.rule.nyx-fleece-shearing.cost_or_limit: The ram must be shorn without injury; the wearer must attune to the garment.
theros.rule.nyx-fleece-shearing.who_may: Anyone able to shear the ram and make the garment; its wearer must attune.
theros.rule.nyx-fleece-shearing.where_from: Nyx-fleece rams and their magical wool.
theros.rule.nyx-fleece-shearing.combines: A die roll determines the garment’s property.
theros.rule.nyx-fleece-shearing.mechanism: Harvested material becomes a power-bearing item.
theros.rule.nyx-fleece-shearing.blocked_reason: The rule creates an item that stores a limited-use or ongoing supernatural power.

theros.rule.mythic-traits.name: Mythic traits

effect.summary: A mythic trait can cause a mid-battle shift, restore resources, or grant new actions and increases the encounter’s stakes.

theros.rule.mythic-traits.cost_or_limit: Optional; using the trait can make an encounter much harder and alter its rewards.
theros.rule.mythic-traits.combines: Mythic actions may accompany mythic traits.
theros.rule.mythic-traits.blocked_reason: This is encounter structure and can be implemented as a state change with new actions.

theros.rule.path-to-the-underworld.name: Path to the Underworld

effect.summary: Some strands of Arasta’s web are rumored to connect near the Underworld’s edge and allow travel to its shores.

theros.rule.path-to-the-underworld.cost_or_limit: Access is rumored and requires reaching Arasta’s lair and web.
theros.rule.path-to-the-underworld.go_wrong: Entrants may be trapped or killed in Arasta’s domain.
theros.rule.path-to-the-underworld.combines: The strands are said to lie near the Underworld’s edge.
theros.rule.path-to-the-underworld.blocked_reason: Travel to the realm of the dead requires representing a distinct Underworld state.

theros.rule.skathos-regional-effects.name: Skathos regional effects

effect.summary: Snakes flourish, trees become petrified wood, nearby plants turn to stone, and small waters become poisonous.

theros.rule.skathos-regional-effects.cost_or_limit: Plant petrification applies within 500 feet after a day; poisonous water affects small bodies within one mile.
theros.rule.skathos-regional-effects.go_wrong: Drinking affected water can poison a creature for eight hours unless it resists or recovers.
theros.rule.skathos-regional-effects.mind: The spectral snakes’ poison causes confusion and impaired thought.
theros.rule.skathos-regional-effects.who_may: Creatures and plants in the region
theros.rule.skathos-regional-effects.combines: Effects are caused by Hythonia’s presence.
theros.rule.skathos-regional-effects.blocked_reason: The continuing effects apply across areas surrounding the lair.
